stem: In a class discussion in Kochi, Ishaan claims Earth supports life while the Moon does not. Which explanation best matches the chapter idea?

options.text: Earth supports life only because it has water; no other conditions matter.
Earth supports life because linked conditions near its surface — such as air, water, soil, food, and shelter — work together.
Earth supports life only because it is the largest rocky planet.
Earth supports life only because sunlight reaches it from the Sun.

teacher.key_rationale: Life as we know it on Earth depends on linked surface conditions and resources, not on any single feature. A, C, and D each isolate one feature and drop the linked-conditions idea.
